In India angle this week with WION's Sidhant Sibal
Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi took part in a series of high-level meetings in Manila this week, attending the ASEAN-India Summit, the East Asia Summit and the Quad leaders’ gathering, the first Quad summit held in a non-member country. Bilateral trade with ASEAN stands at roughly $122–128 billion; New Delhi continues to seek a review of the 2009 goods agreement to improve market access and address non-tariff barriers.
